create-ppt — Casper Studios deck skill

A branded deck you can still edit.

create-ppt takes a brief, an outline or finished copy and writes a native PowerPoint, a review PDF and speaker notes. Every chart, line and word stays a real object you can change after handoff, in the Casper or Sphera theme. The rest of this page walks through how it works.

Design system

One slide anatomy, two brand expressions.

Casper and Sphera use the same layout geometry. Theme tokens change color, typography and decorative details without changing the story or the data.

    What's updated

    The next step for the deck generator.

    create-ppt grows out of one predecessor, casper-deck-generator. Same editable charts, same source-tagging. What changed is how a deck gets made. Each row is the before and the after.

    casper-deck-generator
    before    		create-ppt
    now
    Making a deck You edit the generator script to produce each deck. You write the words in a short content file. The engine is never opened.
    Adding a brand Colors and fonts are written into the code, so a second brand means copying the whole generator. Colors and fonts are named tokens in one file, so a new brand is a single object. Sphera was added that way.
    Layouts A fixed set of slide components built into the script. A template library that lives in the repo. Improving one template improves every deck that uses it, and the team can add more.
    Review Whoever made the deck judged it by eye. A written checklist ships with the skill and reads every slide before you see it.
    Output Casper-branded .pptx, charts drawn as real editable shapes. The same editable .pptx, now in the Casper or Sphera theme, plus a review PDF and speaker notes.

    Not part of this: casper-doc-generator is a sibling that makes Word documents. It keeps running as-is. create-ppt only handles decks, so it neither replaces nor extends it.
